description: This file contains the implementation of a local KMeans clustering utility object, including the kMeansPlusPlus method for initialization and Lloyd's algorithm for clustering iterations, along with helper functions.

classes.name: LocalKMeans
classes.description: A private object providing local KMeans clustering functionalities, including initialization and iterative refinement.

methods.name: kMeansPlusPlus
methods.description: Performs K-means++ initialization and Lloyd's algorithm for clustering, returning cluster centers.

methods.name: pickWeighted
methods.description: Selects a weighted random element from a data array based on provided weights.
